method: Headless Chrome (playwright-core) screenshots of urnieta.com home, /jimny/, /news/, site search (jimny / salado / 1970), all 10 SALADO JB74 product pages that carry vehicle photos and all 8 1970 product pages, plus the official Instagram and Facebook pages. Every real-photo and featured image on those pages (173 files) was pulled into the session scratchpad only and inspected; hex values are median pixel samples under studio or overcast light and are indicative only. Instagram/Facebook loaded but showed only a login wall / thumbnails with nothing beyond the site photos.
summaryNote: URNIETA 官網沒有任何文字寫出示範車的車色；以下全部是從官方照片判讀。SALADO 有兩台主力示範車（白、消光黑），另有一台 JC74 五門奶茶色車與 1970 那台銀車也裝過 SALADO 零件；1970 只有一台示範車（銀）。

otherCarsSeen: A JC74 5-door in a beige/sand colour (looks like Chiffon Ivory ZVG, mono roof) wearing the SALADO bull bar, grille, rack and side bars — salado-front-bumper real-photo-03, salado-hood-kit real-photo-01, salado-roof-rack real-photo-04/05. It is a 5-door, so not a JB74 reference.
The silver 1970 car also carries the SALADO snorkel and rack; SALADO-Snorkel-Kit Real-Photos-01/02 show it.
decisionForOrchestrator: SALADO has two JB74 demo cars. Recommend white ZVR mono roof as the kit card's colour (it is the launch hero); matte black is the alternative but is not a Suzuki colour.
